name: Perpetual calendar-timing differential
hypothesis: Enter matched opposite contracts only when a time-aligned cashflow forecast and live basis justify the trade.
spec: Setup: Venues with different payment clocks can create temporary pricing differences. Entry: Enter matched opposite contracts only when a time-aligned cashflow forecast and live basis justify the trade. Evaluate only information available at decision time; attempt execution afterward. Exit: Exit before the next unmodeled payment or at basis convergence. Always apply the earlier of the registered maximum holding time and hard risk invalidation; fills can be delayed or unavailable. Parameters to pre-register: eligible universe and point-in-time membership, observation window and completed-event/bar rule, numerical threshold(s) named by the signal, entry order and maximum price/quote deviation, initial invalidation level and target if used, H_max and explicit session definition, cost, impact, latency, failed-attempt, and leg-risk models, position/notional/exit-capacity caps, baseline and out-of-sample rejection thresholds.
blocked_reason: needs funding/basis history and hedged derivative legs (not connected)
